subject: Cohort credit identity transfer and invoice mapping
messages:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@northforge.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Rossi <elena@campusaccelerator.org>
Date: 2027-04-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Cohort credits — transferability & invoice mapping

Hi Vivek / Laura,

Quick question from our side as the cohort wraps up next week. We were issued a block of $12k in accelerator credits tied to the program enrollment, but two founders changed their primary emails mid-program. Procurement needs to map consumption to the legal entity for invoicing and our finance team is asking: can Redwood reissue or reassign credits from one account/email to another?

Specifics:
- Original credits assigned to: alice@northforge.ai and bob@northforge.ai
- New emails: alice.singh@northforge.ai (different alias) and product@northforge.ai (shared mailbox)
- We also have a campus partner (Elena) requesting an educational discount on top of the credits — is stacking allowed, and if so, how is that reflected on the invoice?

Procurement is also asking for a document they can attach to their PO demonstrating the credits will be applied before the invoice posts. Any guidance appreciated — procurement is copied (procurement@northforge.ai).

Thanks,
Sanjay
Program Lead — NorthForge Labs
[Attachment: NF-Accelerator-T&C_v2.pdf (pdf)]

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@northforge.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cohort credits — transferability & invoice mapping

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the clear summary. Short answers up front:

1) Reissue / Transfer: We can do a one-time reissue of cohort credits to new verified account identities, but it requires an approved reissue form and proof of ownership/change (e.g., a forwarded company HR or admin note). We do not allow unrestricted credit fungibility between unrelated legal entities.

2) Shared mailboxes / aliases: For shared mailboxes like product@northforge.ai we require a designated billing admin user (an internal user with an email) to be registered as the party that redeems credits. We can map credits to a billing profile rather than a single inbox so that shared mailboxes work operationally.

3) Stacking discounts: Educational discounts can stack with program credits, but they are treated as separate line items. The invoice will reflect: (a) gross usage, (b) promo/educational discount line, (c) credit allocation line(s) showing the $12k deduction(s). We can provide a proforma that demonstrates the order.

Action items I need from you to proceed with a reissue:
- Completed credit-reissue-request-form (see attached template)
- Proof of email ownership/change (HR note or copy of alias setup)
- Confirmation of which billing profile (legal entity) the credits should be mapped to

If you want an exception to our standard one-time reissue (e.g., reassign across sub-accounts inside the same parent company), please say so — we can escalate for approval but will need sign-off from our finance lead.

I attached our short form and the current T&Cs for the cohort. If you'd like, I can provisionally reserve the credits on our side for 7 days while procurement gathers paperwork.

Cheers,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Growth — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: credit-reissue-request-form.pdf (pdf)]

From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@northforge.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Date: 2027-04-02T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Cohort credits — transferability & invoice mapping

Thanks Vivek — that helps. Procurement confirmed they can send the HR proof and want the reserve while they prepare the PO. Two follow-ups:

1) Timeline: can you confirm the 7-day reservation is workable and whether it can be extended to 14 days if procurement requests it?
2) Legal hold: our legal team wants the credit-reissue as a simple signed addendum (no price change) — do you have a stock addendum we can sign, or will this be a bespoke DocuSign?

Elena: if stacking is allowed, would your campus discount team be comfortable sharing a short blurb (one paragraph) that we can attach to the PO describing the education discount?

We can get you the completed form and HR note by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Sanjay

Proposed internal play:

- Marissa: if finance needs to sign an addendum, use our standard "credit-apply addendum" template (see drive: /legal/templates/credit-addendum-v1). Laura, please be on standby for exec approval if procurement pushes for a larger policy carveout.

Ben/Marissa/Laura — confirm by EOD so I can reply to Sanjay and release the reservation.

Vivek
